sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: archive.org item window (link preview): a new "Images" section shows every picture the uploader added (cover, back, booklet, …), not just archive.org's tile. A click opens them in the viewer, and ← → step through all of them. A click on the cover now opens the cover itself at full size.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: archive.org search table: the Collection column lists one collection per line and links each one to its archive.org page. It names them as archive.org does ("Radio Nowhere", "Recordings of Independent Origin") rather than by their ids. This costs one more request to archive.org for a page that brings new collections.
